stages.name: native_lafan40_cuda_pilot
stages.acceptance: Complete bounded training; native world model, actor and critic checkpoints are readable and finite; retain logs and resolved configuration.
stages.limitation: A startup and checkpoint pilot, not complete-clip policy evaluation or a paper result.

stages.name: paper_configuration_alignment
required_differences_from_public_default: Adam instead of hidden-layer Muon, with paper-specific beta values
Cosine learning rate decay to 0.03 times initial over 250000 iterations
Training horizon of 320000 iterations and evaluation every 4000
Explicit full-state resume if runs are interrupted
stages.utd_note: Public replay_ratio=16 yields 4096/(10*2048*8)*16 = 0.4 model/policy updates per simulator collection step; these are two parameterizations of the same update rate.

stages.name: bones_training_set_benchmark
unresolved: Exact author name-filter list and surviving-clip manifest are absent from inspected source
Floating-feet filter's upright, standing-height and stationary gates are not numerically specified in the paper text
Public SuperMimic training entry does not implement two-GPU gradient synchronization

evaluation.denominator: all frozen benchmark motions, including failed trajectories
evaluation.claim: coverage of training motions, not unseen-motion generalization

hardware_limit: Physical robot experiments require a robot; simulation alone cannot validate those results.
